text.en:
The articles specifically listed in "Annex A" hereof, as classified under Section
104 of the Tariff and Customs Code of 1978, as amended, shall be subject to the rates of import
duty in accordance with the schedule indicated opposite each article.
2. The nomenclature and the rates of import duty on tariff headings not
enumerated and those listed but represented by the symbol "XXX" shall remain in force and
3. Upon the effectivity of this Executive Order, the articles specifically listed in
the aforesaid "Annex" which are entered or withdrawn from warehouses in the Philippines for
consumption shall be levied the rates of duty herein prescribed.
4. All other Presidential issuances, administrative rules and regulations, or parts
thereof, which are inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby revoked or modified
accordingly.
5. This Executive Order shall be effective for a period of six months (6) months
which shall commence immediately following its complete publication in two (2) newspapers of
general circulation in the Philippines.
Done in the City of Manila, this 16TH day of April in the year of our Lord,
Two Thousand and Three.
By the President.
ALBERTO C. ROMULO
Executive Secretary
